translations.idiomatic: We respectfully note that according to the Zhenguan Rites, on sacrificial days the military dance performs only six changes, just as Zhou's Dawu stopped the music after six completions.

sentences.zh: 按乐有因人而作者，则因人而止。

translations.literal: In music, if a piece is made because of a person, then it also stops according to that person.
translations.idiomatic: In music, if a piece is made because of a person, then it also stops according to that person.

sentences.zh: 如著成数者，数终即止，不得取行事赊促为乐终早晚，即礼云三阕、六成、八变、九变是也。

translations.literal: If a completed number is specified, then it stops when the number ends; one may not take the slowness or haste of the ceremony as the early or late endpoint of the music. This is what the rites mean by three sections, six completions, eight changes, and nine changes.
translations.idiomatic: If a completed number is specified, then it stops when the number ends; one may not take the slowness or haste of the ceremony as the early or late endpoint of the music. This is what the rites mean by three sections, six completions, eight changes, and nine changes.

sentences.zh: 今礼奏武舞六成，而数终未止，既非师古，不可依行。

translations.literal: In the present rites, the military dance is played through six completions, yet it does not stop when the count is finished. Since this does not model itself on antiquity, it cannot be followed in practice.
translations.idiomatic: In the present rites, the military dance is played through six completions, yet it does not stop when the count is finished. Since this does not model itself on antiquity, it cannot be followed in practice.

sentences.zh: 其武舞《凯安》，望请依古礼及《贞观礼》，六成乐止。

translations.literal: As for the military dance Kai'an, we hope to request that, following the ancient rites and the Zhenguan Rites, the music stop after six completions.
translations.idiomatic: As for the military dance Kai'an, we hope to request that, following the ancient rites and the Zhenguan Rites, the music stop after six completions.

sentences.zh: 立部伎内《破阵乐》五十二遍，修入雅乐，只有两遍，名曰《七德》。

translations.literal: Within the standing-section performances, Pozhen yue has fifty-two repetitions; when revised into elegant music, it has only two repetitions and is named Qide.
translations.idiomatic: Within the standing-section performances, Pozhen yue has fifty-two repetitions; when revised into elegant music, it has only two repetitions and is named Qide.

sentences.zh: 立部伎内《庆善乐》七遍，修入雅乐，只有一遍，名曰《九功》。

translations.literal: Within the standing-section performances, Qingshan yue has seven repetitions; when revised into elegant music, it has only one repetition and is named Jiugong.
translations.idiomatic: Within the standing-section performances, Qingshan yue has seven repetitions; when revised into elegant music, it has only one repetition and is named Jiugong.

sentences.zh: 《上元舞》二十九遍，今入雅乐，一无所减。

translations.literal: The Shangyuan Dance has twenty-nine repetitions, and now that it has entered elegant music, not one has been reduced.
translations.idiomatic: The Shangyuan Dance has twenty-nine repetitions, and now that it has entered elegant music, not one has been reduced.

sentences.zh: 每见祭享日三献已终，《上元舞》犹自未毕，今更加《破阵乐》、《庆善乐》，兼恐酌献已后，歌舞更长。

translations.literal: Whenever we observe sacrificial days, after the three offerings have already ended, the Shangyuan Dance is still not finished. Now Pozhen yue and Qingshan yue are added besides, and we fear that after the libation offerings, the songs and dances will become still longer.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever we observe sacrificial days, after the three offerings have already ended, the Shangyuan Dance is still not finished. Now Pozhen yue and Qingshan yue are added besides, and we fear that after the libation offerings, the songs and dances will become still longer.

sentences.zh: 其雅乐内《破阵乐》、《庆善乐》及《上元舞》三曲，并望修改通融，令长短与礼相称，冀望久长安稳。

translations.literal: As for the three pieces within elegant music, Pozhen yue, Qingshan yue, and Shangyuan wu, we hope they will all be revised and harmonized, making their lengths correspond to the rites, in the hope of long-term stability.
translations.idiomatic: As for the three pieces within elegant music, Pozhen yue, Qingshan yue, and Shangyuan wu, we hope they will all be revised and harmonized, making their lengths correspond to the rites, in the hope of long-term stability.

sentences.zh: 《破阵乐》有象武事，《庆善乐》有象文事。

translations.literal: Pozhen yue symbolizes martial affairs, and Qingshan yue symbolizes civil affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Pozhen yue symbolizes martial affairs, and Qingshan yue symbolizes civil affairs.

sentences.zh: 按古六代舞，有《云门》、《大咸》、《大夏》、《大韶》，是古之文舞；殷之《大濩》，周之《大武》是古之武舞。

translations.literal: Considering the ancient dances of the six dynasties, Yunmen, Daxian, Daxia, and Dashao were the civil dances of antiquity; Yin's Dahu and Zhou's Dawu were the military dances of antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Considering the ancient dances of the six dynasties, Yunmen, Daxian, Daxia, and Dashao were the civil dances of antiquity; Yin's Dahu and Zhou's Dawu were the military dances of antiquity.

sentences.zh: 依古义，先儒相传，国家以揖让得天下，则先奏文舞。

translations.literal: According to the ancient meaning transmitted by earlier Confucians, when a state obtains All Under Heaven by yielding ceremony, it first performs the civil dance.
translations.idiomatic: According to the ancient meaning transmitted by earlier Confucians, when a state obtains All Under Heaven by yielding ceremony, it first performs the civil dance.

sentences.zh: 若以征伐得天下，则先奏武舞。

translations.literal: If it obtains All Under Heaven by campaigns and conquest, it first performs the military dance.
translations.idiomatic: If it obtains All Under Heaven by campaigns and conquest, it first performs the military dance.

sentences.zh: 望请应用二舞日，先奏《神功破阵乐》，次奏《功成庆善乐》。

translations.literal: We hope to request that on days when the two dances are used, Shengong Pozhen yue be performed first, followed by Gongcheng Qingshan yue.
translations.idiomatic: We hope to request that on days when the two dances are used, Shengong Pozhen yue be performed first, followed by Gongcheng Qingshan yue.

sentences.zh: 先奉敕于圆丘、方泽、太庙祠享日，则用《上元》之舞。

translations.literal: Earlier we received an edict that on sacrificial days at the Circular Mound, the Square Marsh, and the Grand Temple, the Shangyuan Dance should be used.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier we received an edict that on sacrificial days at the Circular Mound, the Square Marsh, and the Grand Temple, the Shangyuan Dance should be used.

sentences.zh: 臣据见行礼，欲于天皇酌献降复位已后，即作《凯安》，六变乐止。

translations.literal: Your servant, on the basis of the rites now in practice, wishes that after the August Sovereign has poured the offering, descended, and returned to his position, Kai'an should then be performed, with the music stopping after six changes.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant, on the basis of the rites now in practice, wishes that after the August Sovereign has poured the offering, descended, and returned to his position, Kai'an should then be performed, with the music stopping after six changes.

sentences.zh: 其《神功破阵乐》、《功成庆善乐》、《上元》之舞三曲，待修改讫，以次通融作之，即得与旧乐前后不相妨破。

translations.literal: As for the three pieces Shengong Pozhen yue, Gongcheng Qingshan yue, and the Shangyuan Dance, after their revision is complete, they should be performed in sequence and with adjustment; then they can avoid conflicting with or disrupting the old music before and after them.
translations.idiomatic: As for the three pieces Shengong Pozhen yue, Gongcheng Qingshan yue, and the Shangyuan Dance, after their revision is complete, they should be performed in sequence and with adjustment; then they can avoid conflicting with or disrupting the old music before and after them.

sentences.zh: 若有司摄行事日，亦请据行事通融。

translations.literal: If the responsible offices conduct the ceremony by proxy, we also request that they harmonize the performance according to the conduct of the rite.
translations.idiomatic: If the responsible offices conduct the ceremony by proxy, we also request that they harmonize the performance according to the conduct of the rite.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The edict was assented to.
translations.idiomatic: Assent was given.

sentences.zh: 三年七月，上在九成宮咸亨殿宴集，有韓王元嘉、霍王元軌及南北軍將軍等。

translations.literal: Seventh month, third year, the emperor feasted at Jiucheng Palace in the Xianheng Hall; Han Prince Yuanjia, Huo Prince Yuan gui, and generals of the northern and southern armies were present.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, seventh month: the emperor feasted at Jiucheng Palace, Xianheng Hall, with Han Prince Yuanjia, Huo Prince Yuan gui, and northern and southern army generals.

sentences.zh: 樂作，太常少卿韋萬石奏稱：「《破陣樂舞》者，是皇祚發跡所由，宣揚宗祖盛烈，傳之於後，永永無窮。

translations.literal: When music began, Vice Director Wei Wanshi memorialized: "The Breaking-the-Array dance is where the imperial fortune took its start; it proclaims the ancestors' glorious achievements, transmitted to posterity without end.
translations.idiomatic: As music began, Wei Wanshi memorialized: "Breaking-the-Array is where imperial fortune began; it proclaims ancestral glory to endless posterity.

sentences.zh: 自天皇臨馭四海，寢而不作，既緣聖情感愴，群下無敢關言。

translations.literal: Since the August Sovereign came to rule all within the four seas it has lain dormant; because the sage's feeling was mournful, no one below dared speak.
translations.idiomatic: Since the August Sovereign ruled the four seas it has lain dormant; the sage's grief was such that none below dared speak.

sentences.zh: 臣忝職樂司，廢缺是懼。

translations.literal: Your servant, holding office in the Music Office, fears neglect and lapse.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant in the Music Office fears neglect.

sentences.zh: 依禮，祭之日，天子親總干戚以舞先祖之樂，與天下同樂之也，今《破陣樂》久廢，群下無所稱述，將何以發孝思之情？」

translations.literal: According to the rites, on the day of sacrifice the Son of Heaven personally takes up shield and axe to dance the music of the former ancestors and share joy with All Under Heaven. Now Pozhen yue has long been abandoned, and those below have nothing to recite; how will this arouse the feeling of filial thought?"
translations.idiomatic: According to the rites, on the day of sacrifice the Son of Heaven personally takes up shield and axe to dance the music of the former ancestors and share joy with All Under Heaven. Now Pozhen yue has long been abandoned, and those below have nothing to recite; how will this arouse the feeling of filial thought?"

sentences.zh: 上矍然改容，俯遂所請，有制令奏樂舞。

translations.literal: The emperor started, changed expression, bowed to grant the request, and ordered the dance performed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor started, changed expression, granted the request, and ordered the dance.

sentences.zh: 既畢，上欷歔感咽，涕泗交流，臣下悲淚，莫能仰視。

translations.literal: When it ended the emperor sighed with feeling, tears streaming; the ministers wept and could not look up.
translations.idiomatic: When it ended the emperor sighed, tears streaming; ministers wept and could not look up.

sentences.zh: 久之，顧謂兩王曰：「不見此樂，垂三十年，乍此觀聽，實深哀感。

translations.literal: After a long while he turned to the two princes and said: "I have not seen this dance for nearly thirty years; suddenly viewing it today truly stirs deep grief.
translations.idiomatic: After long silence he told the two princes: "Nearly thirty years without this dance; seeing it today stirs deep grief.

sentences.zh: 追思往日，王業艱難勤苦若此，朕今嗣守洪業，可忘武功？

translations.literal: Recalling past days, the royal enterprise was arduous and toilsome like this; I now inherit and guard the great enterprise—can I forget military achievement?
translations.idiomatic: Recalling the past, the royal enterprise was toilsome like this; I now guard the great enterprise—can I forget martial achievement?

sentences.zh: 古人云：『富貴不與驕奢期，驕奢自至。』

translations.literal: The ancients said: "Wealth and nobility do not appoint an appointment with pride and extravagance—pride and extravagance arrive of themselves."
translations.idiomatic: The ancients said: "Wealth and nobility do not fix a date with pride and extravagance—pride and extravagance come of themselves."

sentences.zh: 朕謂時見此舞，以自誡勖，冀無盈滿之過，非為歡樂奏陳之耳。」

translations.literal: I say that seeing this dance from time to time is to admonish and encourage myself, hoping to have no fault of fullness and excess; it is not for pleasure that it is performed and displayed."
translations.idiomatic: I say that seeing this dance from time to time is to admonish and encourage myself, hoping to have no fault of fullness and excess; it is not for pleasure that it is performed and displayed."

sentences.zh: 侍宴群臣咸呼萬歲。

translations.literal: The attending ministers all shouted long life.
translations.idiomatic: Attending ministers shouted long life.

sentences.zh: 正月二十一日，則天御洛城南樓賜宴，太常奏《六合還淳》之舞。

translations.literal: Twenty-first day of the first month, Wu Zetian held a feast from the southern tower of Luoyang and the Court performed the Returning to Purity of the Six Harmony dance.
translations.idiomatic: First month, twenty-first day: Wu Zetian feasted from Luoyang's south tower; the Court performed Six Harmony Returning to Purity.

sentences.zh: 正月，則天親享萬象神宮。

translations.literal: First month, Wu Zetian personally offered at the Temple of Myriad Images.
translations.idiomatic: First month: Wu Zetian personally offered at the Temple of Myriad Images.

sentences.zh: 先是，上自製《神宮大樂》，舞用九百人，至是舞於神宮之庭，

translations.literal: Earlier the emperor had composed the Grand Music of the Spirit Palace, danced by nine hundred persons; on this occasion it was danced in the spirit palace courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the emperor had composed Spirit Palace Grand Music for nine hundred dancers; now it was danced in the spirit palace courtyard.

sentences.zh: 景龍二年，皇后上言：「自妃主及五品以上母妻，並不因夫子封者，請自今遷葬之日，特給鼓吹。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jinglong, the empress memorialized: "From consorts and princesses down to mothers and wives of fifth rank and above who had not been ennobled through husband or son, from the day of relocation burial hereafter specially grant drum-and-pipe music.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jinglong, the empress memorialized: "Consorts, princesses, and fifth-rank-and-above mothers and wives not ennobled through husband or son should receive drum-and-pipe music from relocation burial onward.

sentences.zh: 宮官亦准此。」

translations.literal: Palace officials should also follow this."
translations.idiomatic: Palace officials should also follow this."

sentences.zh: 侍御史唐紹上諫曰：「竊聞鼓吹之作，本為軍容，昔黃帝涿鹿有功，以為警衛。

translations.literal: Attendant censor Tang Shao remonstrated: "Your servant has heard that the drum-and-pipe performance was originally for military display; in antiquity when the Yellow Emperor achieved merit at Zhuolu it served as guard music.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant censor Tang Shao remonstrated: "Drum-and-pipe music was originally military display; when the Yellow Emperor won at Zhuolu it served as guard music.

sentences.zh: 故鼓曲有《靈夔吼》、《雕鶚爭》、《石墜崖》、《壯士怒》之類。

translations.literal: Hence drum pieces include Spirit Rhinoceros Roaring, Eagle and Falcon Struggling, Stone Falling from the Cliff, and Valiant's Wrath.
translations.idiomatic: Drum pieces include Spirit Rhinoceros Roaring, Eagle and Falcon Struggling, Stone Falling from the Cliff, and Valiant's Wrath.

sentences.zh: 自昔功臣備禮，適得用之。

translations.literal: From of old meritorious subjects received the full rites—only then might it be used.
translations.idiomatic: Meritorious subjects alone received it by full rite.

sentences.zh: 丈夫有四方之功，所以恩加寵錫。

translations.literal: A man with achievement in the four directions receives favor and generous reward.
translations.idiomatic: Men with achievement in the four directions receive favor and reward.

sentences.zh: 假如郊祀天地，誠是重儀，惟有宮懸，本無案架。

translations.literal: Suppose suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth—truly a weighty rite—only palace suspended music exists; there are no frame-drum racks by nature.
translations.idiomatic: Suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth is a weighty rite with only palace suspended music—no frame-drum racks.

sentences.zh: 故知軍樂所備，尚不洽於神祇；

translations.literal: Hence one knows that what military music provides still does not suit the spirits;
translations.idiomatic: Military music therefore does not suit the spirits;

sentences.zh: 鉦鼓之音，豈得接於閨閫。

translations.literal: how can the sound of bells and drums meet the inner quarters?
translations.idiomatic: how can bells and drums enter the inner quarters?

sentences.zh: 准式，公主王妃已下葬禮，惟有團扇、方扇、彩帷、錦障之色。

translations.literal: By regulation, burial rites for princesses and imperial consorts and below have only round fans, square fans, colored curtains, and brocade screens.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations for princesses and consorts and below allow only round fans, square fans, colored curtains, and brocade screens at burial.

sentences.zh: 加至鼓吹，歷代未聞。

translations.literal: Adding drum-and-pipe—no generation has heard of it.
translations.idiomatic: Adding drum-and-pipe is unheard of in any generation.

sentences.zh: 又准令，五品官婚葬，先無鼓吹，惟京官五品，得借四品鼓吹為儀。

translations.literal: Moreover by statute, fifth-rank officials' weddings and burials had no drum-and-pipe; only capital officials of fifth rank might borrow fourth-rank drum-and-pipe for ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Statute gave fifth-rank weddings and burials no drum-and-pipe; only capital fifth-rank officials might borrow fourth-rank drum-and-pipe.

sentences.zh: 令特給五品已上母妻，五品官則不當給限。

translations.literal: Now to grant specially to mothers and wives of fifth rank and above means fifth-rank officials receive what the statute forbids.
translations.idiomatic: Granting it to fifth-rank mothers and wives gives fifth-rank officials what statute forbids.

sentences.zh: 便是班秩本因夫子，儀飾乃復過之，事非倫次，難為定制，參詳義理，不可常行。

translations.literal: Thus rank itself derives from husband and son yet ceremonial display exceeds them—illogical and hard to fix as rule; weighing the moral logic, it cannot be routinely done.
translations.idiomatic: Rank derives from husband and son yet display exceeds them—illogical and hard to codify; on moral grounds it cannot be routine.

sentences.zh: 請停前敕，各依常典。」

translations.literal: We request that the previous edict be stopped and that each follow the regular statutes."
translations.idiomatic: We request that the previous edict be stopped and that each follow the regular statutes."

sentences.zh: 上不納。

translations.literal: The emperor did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: The throne declined.

sentences.zh: 延載元年正月二十三日，製《越古長年樂》一曲。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yanzai, twenty-third day of the first month, composed the melody Transcending Antiquity, Long Years.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yanzai, first month, twenty-third day: composed Transcending Antiquity, Long Years.

sentences.zh: 玄宗在位多年，善音樂，若宴設酺會，即禦勤政樓。

translations.literal: When Xuanzong reigned many years he was skilled in music; whenever he held banquets or public revels he went to the Diligence in Governance Tower.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong reigned many years and was skilled in music; banquets and public revels were held at the Diligence in Governance Tower.

sentences.zh: 先一日，金吾引駕仗北衙四軍甲士，未明陳仗，衛尉張設，光祿造食。

translations.literal: The day before, the commandants of the four armies of the northern palace guard led armored troops; before dawn they arrayed equipment; the Minister of Ceremonies set screens; the Director of Palace Provisions prepared food.
translations.idiomatic: The day before, northern palace guard commandants of four armies led armored troops; before dawn they arrayed gear; the Minister of Ceremonies set screens; the Director of Palace Provisions prepared food.

sentences.zh: 候明，百僚朝，侍中進中嚴外辦，中官素扇，天子開簾受朝。

translations.literal: At daybreak the hundred officials attended court; the palace secretariat announced inner solemnity and outer readiness; eunuchs with plain fans; the Son of Heaven opened the curtain to receive homage.
translations.idiomatic: At daybreak the hundred officials attended; the secretariat announced inner solemnity and outer readiness; eunuchs with plain fans; the Son of Heaven opened the curtain for homage.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，又素扇垂簾，百僚常參供奉官、貴戚、二王后、諸蕃酋長，謝食就坐。

translations.literal: When rites concluded plain fans lowered the curtain again; regular court officials, tribute officers, nobles, two kings, and tribal chiefs took food and sat.
translations.idiomatic: When rites ended, plain fans lowered the curtain; regular court, tribute officers, nobles, two kings, and tribal chiefs ate and sat.

sentences.zh: 太常大鼓，藻繪如錦，樂工齊擊，聲震城闕。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices' great drums, painted like brocade; musicians struck together; sound shook the gate-towers.
translations.idiomatic: Court great drums painted like brocade; musicians struck together; sound shook the gate-towers.

sentences.zh: 太常卿引雅樂，每色數十人，自南魚貫而進，列於樓下。

translations.literal: The Director led elegant music; dozens per tone-color entered from the south in file and ranked below the tower.
translations.idiomatic: The Director led elegant music; dozens per tone-color filed in from the south and ranked below the tower.

sentences.zh: 鼓笛雞婁，充庭考擊。

translations.literal: Drums, flutes, gourds and lutes filled the courtyard in performance.
translations.idiomatic: Drums, flutes, gourds, and lutes filled the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 太常樂立部伎、坐部伎依點鼓舞，間以胡夷之伎。

translations.literal: Standing-section and seated-section performers of the Court danced by counted beats, interspersed with barbarian and foreign pieces.
translations.idiomatic: Court standing- and seated-section performers danced by counted beats, interspersed with barbarian and foreign pieces.

sentences.zh: 日旰，即內閑廄引蹀馬三十匹，為《傾杯樂曲》，奮首鼓尾，縱橫應節。

translations.literal: At sundown the inner stables led thirty pacing horses for the Tilting Cup melody; they tossed heads and drummed tails, moving across in rhythm.
translations.idiomatic: At sundown the inner stables led thirty pacing horses for Tilting Cup; they tossed heads and drummed tails in rhythm.

sentences.zh: 又施三層板床，乘馬而上，抃轉如飛。

translations.literal: A three-tier plank bed was set up; they mounted and whirled like flight.
translations.idiomatic: A three-tier plank bed was set; they mounted and whirled like flight.

sentences.zh: 又令宮女數百人自帷出擊雷鼓，為《破陣樂》、《太平樂》、《上元樂》。

translations.literal: He also ordered several hundred palace women to emerge from curtains striking thunder-drums, performing Breaking the Array, Grand Peace, and Shangyuan pieces.
translations.idiomatic: He also had several hundred palace women emerge from curtains striking thunder-drums in Breaking the Array, Grand Peace, and Shangyuan.

sentences.zh: 雖太常積習，皆不如其妙也。

translations.literal: Though the Court had long practice, none matched this marvel.
translations.idiomatic: Though the Court had long practice, none matched this.

sentences.zh: 若《聖壽樂》，則回身換衣，作字如畫。

translations.literal: For Longevity of Sagehood they turned bodies changing dress, forming characters like painting.
translations.idiomatic: In Longevity of Sagehood they turned bodies, changed dress, and formed characters like painting.

sentences.zh: 又五坊使引大象入場，或拜或舞，動容鼓振，中於音律，竟日而退。

translations.literal: Envoys of the five workshops also led elephants in; some bowed, some danced, movements striking drums in rhythm with the pitch—performing all day before retiring.
translations.idiomatic: Five-workshop envoys also led elephants in; some bowed, some danced, movements and drums in pitch—performing all day.

sentences.zh: 玄宗又於聽政之暇，教太常樂工子弟三百人為絲竹之戲，音響齊發，有一聲誤，玄宗必覺而正之。

translations.literal: In leisure from government Xuanzong taught three hundred sons of Court musicians in silk-and-bamboo pieces; when tones rose together, if one note erred he detected and corrected it.
translations.idiomatic: In leisure from government he taught three hundred Court musicians' sons silk-and-bamboo; if one note erred when tones rose together, he detected and corrected it.

sentences.zh: 號為皇帝弟子，又云梨園弟子，以置院近于禁苑之梨園。

translations.literal: They were styled Imperial Disciples, also Pear Garden disciples, because the academy lay near the Pear Garden within the forbidden park.
translations.idiomatic: They were styled Imperial Disciples, also Pear Garden disciples, from the academy near the forbidden Pear Garden.

sentences.zh: 太常又有別教院，教供奉新曲。

translations.literal: The Court also had a separate teaching academy for instructing new tribute pieces.
translations.idiomatic: The Court also had a separate teaching academy for new tribute pieces.

sentences.zh: 太常每淩晨，鼓笛亂發于太樂署。

translations.literal: Each dawn the Court's drums and flutes sounded together at the Grand Music Office.
translations.idiomatic: Each dawn Court drums and flutes sounded together at the Grand Music Office.

sentences.zh: 別教院廩食常千人，宮中居宜春院。

translations.literal: The separate teaching academy had grain rations for a thousand men regularly; musicians dwelled at the Yichun Courtyard within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: The separate teaching academy rationed a thousand men; musicians dwelled at palace Yichun Courtyard.

sentences.zh: 玄宗又製新曲四十餘，又新製樂譜。

translations.literal: Xuanzong also composed more than forty new pieces and new musical scores.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong also composed more than forty new pieces and new scores.

sentences.zh: 每初年望夜，又禦勤政樓，觀燈作樂，貴臣戚里，借看樓觀望。

translations.literal: Each year on the first full-moon night of the first month he again went to the Diligence Tower to view lanterns and make music; noble ministers and kin borrowed tower rooms to watch.
translations.idiomatic: Each year on the first full-moon night he again went to the Diligence Tower for lanterns and music; nobles and kin borrowed tower rooms to watch.

sentences.zh: 夜闌，太常樂府縣散樂畢，即遣宮女于樓前縛架出眺，歌舞以娛之。

translations.literal: When night deepened and scattered music of the Court and prefectures ended, palace women were sent to bind frames before the tower and perform rope acts and pole climbing to entertain.
translations.idiomatic: When night deepened and Court and prefectural scattered music ended, palace women bound frames before the tower for rope acts and pole climbing.

sentences.zh: 若繩戲竿木，詭異巧妙，固無其比，

translations.literal: Rope games and pole-wood feats—strange and artful—had no equal.
translations.idiomatic: Rope games and pole feats—strange and artful—had no equal.

sentences.zh: 天寶十五載，玄宗西幸，祿山遣其逆党載京師樂器樂伎衣盡入洛城。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Tianbao, when Xuanzong fled west, An Lushan sent his rebel cohorts to transport the capital's musical instruments and musicians' robes all into Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Tianbao, when Xuanzong fled west, An Lushan's rebels hauled the capital's instruments and musicians' robes into Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 尋而肅宗克復兩京，將行大體，禮物盡闕。

translations.literal: Soon after Suzong recovered the two capitals and was to perform the great rites, ritual objects were wholly lacking.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Suzong recovered the two capitals; for the great rites ritual objects were wholly lacking.

sentences.zh: 命禮儀使太常少卿于休烈使屬吏與東京留臺領，赴於朝廷。

translations.literal: He ordered Ritual Commissioner and Vice Director of the Court Yu Xiulie to send subordinates with the Eastern Capital's retained court to proceed to the court.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Ritual Commissioner and Court Vice Director Yu Xiulie to send subordinates with the Eastern Capital retained court to the capital.

sentences.zh: 詔給錢，使休烈造伎衣及大舞等服，於是樂工二舞始備矣。

translations.literal: Edict granted money, had Xiulie make performers' robes and great-dance garments; then music workers and the two dances were complete.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted money for Xiulie to make performers' robes and great-dance dress; then musicians and the two dances were complete.

sentences.zh: 三月十九日，上乙太常舊鐘磬，自隋已來所傳五聲，或有差錯，謂于休烈曰：「古者聖人作樂，以應天地之和，以合陰陽之序。

translations.literal: Nineteenth day of the third month, the emperor personally inspected the Court's old bells and chimes; since Sui the transmitted five tones had some errors; he said to Yu Xiulie: "In antiquity the sage made music to respond to heaven-and-earth's harmony and match yin-yang's sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, nineteenth day: the emperor inspected the Court's old bells and chimes; since Sui the five transmitted tones had errors; he told Yu Xiulie: "The sage made music to match heaven-and-earth's harmony and yin-yang's order.

sentences.zh: 和則人不夭劄，物不疵癘。

translations.literal: When in harmony people do not die young and things are not blighted.
translations.idiomatic: In harmony people do not die young and things are not blighted.

sentences.zh: 且金石絲竹，樂之器也。

translations.literal: Moreover metal, stone, silk, and bamboo are the instruments of music.
translations.idiomatic: Metal, stone, silk, and bamboo are the instruments of music.

sentences.zh: 比親享郊廟，每聽樂聲，或宮商不倫，或鐘磬失度。

translations.literal: Recently, when personally performing suburban and temple sacrifices, whenever I heard the music, sometimes the gong and shang modes were out of order, or the bells and chimes were off pitch.
translations.idiomatic: Lately, whenever I attended suburban and temple sacrifices and heard the music, the gong and shang modes were sometimes disordered, or the bells and chimes were out of tune.

sentences.zh: 可盡供鐘磬，朕當於內自定。」

translations.literal: Provide all the bells and chimes; I shall personally fix them inside the palace."
translations.idiomatic: Provide all the bells and chimes; I shall personally fix them inside the palace."

sentences.zh: 太常進入，上集樂工考試數日，審知差錯，然後令再造及磨刻。

translations.literal: The Grand Minister of Ceremonial presented them. The emperor assembled the musicians and tested them for several days, carefully learned the errors, and then ordered them recast and ground or engraved.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Minister of Ceremonial presented them. The emperor assembled the musicians and tested them for several days, carefully learned the errors, and then ordered them recast and ground or engraved.

sentences.zh: 二十五日，一部先畢，召太常樂工，上臨三殿親觀考擊，皆合五音，送太常。

translations.literal: On the twenty-fifth day, one set was first completed; he summoned the music workers of the Grand Minister of Ceremonial; the emperor went in person to the Three Halls to observe the testing and striking—all matched the five tones—and sent them to the Grand Minister of Ceremonial.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-fifth day one set was finished first. He summoned the directorate's music workers, went in person to the Three Halls to watch the trial performances, found that all matched the five tones, and sent the set to the Grand Minister of Ceremonial.

sentences.zh: 二十八日，又于內造樂章三十一章，送太常，郊廟歌之。

translations.literal: On the twenty-eighth day, he also within the palace composed thirty-one musical pieces and sent them to the Grand Minister of Ceremonial for suburban and temple sacrifices to sing them.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-eighth day he also composed thirty-one pieces within the palace and sent them to the Grand Minister of Ceremonial to be sung at suburban and temple rites.

sentences.zh: 貞元三年四月，河東節度使馬燧獻《定難曲》。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenyuan, fourth month: Hedong Military Commissioner Ma Sui presented "Quelling Disturbances."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhenyuan, in the fourth month, Hedong Military Commissioner Ma Sui presented the "Quelling Disturbances" suite.

sentences.zh: 御麟德殿，命閱試之。

translations.literal: He proceeded to Linde Hall and ordered it reviewed and tested.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor went to Linde Hall and ordered it performed for review.

sentences.zh: 十二年十二月，昭義軍節度使王虔休獻《繼天誕聖樂》。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, twelfth month: Zhaoyi Circuit Military Commissioner Wang Qianxiu presented "Continuing Heaven's Birthday Sacred Music."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, twelfth month, Zhaoyi Military Commissioner Wang Qianxiu presented the "Continuing Heaven's Birthday Sacred Music."

sentences.zh: 十四年二月，德宗自製《中和舞》，又奏《九部樂》及禁中歌舞。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, second month: Dezong personally composed the "Zhonghe Dance," and also presented the Nine Department Music and palace song-dances.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, second month, Dezong personally composed the "Zhonghe Dance" and also had the Nine Department Music and palace song-dances performed.

sentences.zh: 伎者十數人，布列在庭，上御麟德殿會百僚觀新樂詩，仍令太子書示百官。

translations.literal: Performers numbering over ten lined up in the court; the emperor proceeded to Linde Hall to assemble the hundred officials to view the new music and poems, and also ordered the Crown Prince to write them out and show the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten performers were arrayed in the courtyard. The emperor went to Linde Hall, gathered the hundred officials to view the new music and poems, and also ordered the Crown Prince to copy them out and display them to the officials.

sentences.zh: 貞元十六年正月，南詔異牟尋作《奉聖樂舞》，因韋皋以進。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Zhenyuan, first month: Nanzhao's Yi Mouxun composed the "Offering to the Sage Music and Dance" and had it presented through Wei Gao.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Zhenyuan, in the first month, Nanzhao's Yi Mouxun composed the "Offering to the Sage Music and Dance" and had Wei Gao present it to the court.

sentences.zh: 十八年正月，驃國王來獻本國樂。

translations.literal: Eighteenth year, first month: the king of Pyu came to present his state's music.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, first month, the king of Pyu came to present his kingdom's music.

sentences.zh: 十月，宣太常寺，准《雲韶樂》舊用人數，令於本寺閱習進來者。

translations.literal: Tenth month: an edict was issued to the Grand Minister of Ceremonial to follow the old personnel count for Yünshao Music and order those newly arrived to rehearse at the directorate.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the throne directed the Grand Minister of Ceremonial to follow the old staffing for Yünshao Music and have the newly arrived musicians rehearse at the directorate.

sentences.zh: 至十月，教成。

translations.literal: By the tenth month, training was complete.
translations.idiomatic: By the tenth month the training was finished.

sentences.zh: 三年，武德司奉宣索《雲韶樂縣圖》二軸，進之。

translations.literal: Third year: the Wude Office received an imperial order seeking two scrolls of the Yünshao Music hanging chart and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the Wude Office received an imperial order for two scrolls of the Yünshao Music hanging chart and presented them.

sentences.zh: 大和三年八月，太常禮院奏：

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year of Taihe, the Grand Minister of Ceremonial Rites Court memorialized:
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year of Taihe, the Grand Minister of Ceremonial Rites Court memorialized:

sentences.zh: 謹按凱樂，鼓吹之歌曲也。

translations.literal: We respectfully note: victory music is the song music of drums and pipes.
translations.idiomatic: We respectfully note: victory music is the song music of drums and pipes.

sentences.zh: 《周官大司樂》：「王師大獻，則奏凱樂。」

translations.literal: The Zhouguan, in "Grand Music Master," says, "When the royal army makes a great presentation, then victory music is performed."
translations.idiomatic: The Zhouguan, in "Grand Music Master," says, "When the royal army makes a great presentation, then victory music is performed."

sentences.zh: 注云：「獻功之樂也。」

translations.literal: The commentary says, "It is music for presenting achievement."
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says, "It is music for presenting achievement."

sentences.zh: 又《大司馬》之職，「師有功，則凱樂獻於社。」

translations.literal: Again, in the office of the "Grand Minister of War," it says, "When the army has achievement, then victory music is presented at the altar of soil."
translations.idiomatic: Again, in the office of the "Grand Minister of War," it says, "When the army has achievement, then victory music is presented at the altar of soil."

sentences.zh: 注云：「兵樂曰凱。」

translations.literal: The commentary says, "Military music is called kai."
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says, "Military music is called kai."

sentences.zh: 《司馬法》曰：「得意則凱樂，所以示喜也。」

translations.literal: The Sima fa says, "When one achieves one's aim, then there is victory music; this is how joy is displayed."
translations.idiomatic: The Sima fa says, "When one achieves one's aim, then there is victory music; this is how joy is displayed."

sentences.zh: 《左氏傳》載晉文公勝楚，振旅凱入。

translations.literal: The Zuo Tradition records that when Duke Wen of Jin defeated Chu, he reformed the army and entered with victory music.
translations.idiomatic: The Zuo Tradition records that when Duke Wen of Jin defeated Chu, he reformed the army and entered with victory music.

sentences.zh: 魏、晉已來鼓吹曲章，多述當時戰功，是則歷代獻捷，必有凱歌。

translations.literal: Since Wei and Jin, drum-and-pipe songs and sections have often narrated the battle achievements of their time; thus, in successive ages, when victory was presented there was certainly a victory song.
translations.idiomatic: Since Wei and Jin, drum-and-pipe songs and sections have often narrated the battle achievements of their time; thus, in successive ages, when victory was presented there was certainly a victory song.

sentences.zh: 太宗平東都，破宋金剛，其後蘇定方執賀魯，李勣平高麗，皆備軍容凱歌入京師。

translations.literal: When Taizong pacified the eastern capital and defeated Song Jingang, and later when Su Dingfang captured Helu and Li Ji pacified Goguryeo, all entered the capital with full military display and victory songs.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong pacified the eastern capital and defeated Song Jingang, and later when Su Dingfang captured Helu and Li Ji pacified Goguryeo, all entered the capital with full military display and victory songs.

sentences.zh: 謹檢《貞觀》、《顯慶》、《開元禮》書，並無儀注。

translations.literal: We have respectfully examined the ritual books of Zhenguan, Xianqing, and Kaiyuan, and none has ritual notes for it.
translations.idiomatic: We have respectfully examined the ritual books of Zhenguan, Xianqing, and Kaiyuan, and none has ritual notes for it.

sentences.zh: 今參酌今古，備其陳設及奏歌曲之儀如後。

translations.literal: Now, considering both present and ancient practice, we set out below the full protocols for its arrangements and for performing the songs.
translations.idiomatic: Now, considering both present and ancient practice, we set out below the full protocols for its arrangements and for performing the songs.

sentences.zh: 凡命將征討，有大功獻俘馘者，其日備神策兵衛於東門外，如獻俘常儀。

translations.literal: Whenever generals are commissioned to campaign and have great achievement, presenting captives and severed left ears, on that day Shence troops and guards should be prepared outside the eastern gate, as in the regular protocol for presenting captives.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever generals are commissioned to campaign and have great achievement, presenting captives and severed left ears, on that day Shence troops and guards should be prepared outside the eastern gate, as in the regular protocol for presenting captives.

sentences.zh: 其凱樂用鐃吹二部，笛、篳篥、簫、笳、鐃、鼓，每色二人，歌工二十四人。

translations.literal: For the victory music, use two divisions of cymbal-and-pipe music: flutes, bili pipes, xiao pipes, jia pipes, cymbals, and drums, with two men for each category, and twenty-four singers.
translations.idiomatic: For the victory music, use two divisions of cymbal-and-pipe music: flutes, bili pipes, xiao pipes, jia pipes, cymbals, and drums, with two men for each category, and twenty-four singers.

sentences.zh: 樂工等乘馬執樂器，次第陳列，如鹵簿之式。

translations.literal: The musicians and others should ride horses and hold their instruments, arrayed in order according to the style of a guard procession.
translations.idiomatic: The musicians and others should ride horses and hold their instruments, arrayed in order according to the style of a guard procession.

sentences.zh: 鼓吹令丞前導，分行於兵馬俘馘之前。

translations.literal: The director and assistant director of drums and pipes should lead in front, proceeding in separate files before the troops, horses, captives, and severed ears.
translations.idiomatic: The director and assistant director of drums and pipes should lead in front, proceeding in separate files before the troops, horses, captives, and severed ears.

sentences.zh: 將入都門，鼓吹振作，迭奏《破陣樂》等四曲。

translations.literal: When about to enter the capital gate, the drums and pipes should sound vigorously, alternating through the four pieces beginning with Pozhen yue.
translations.idiomatic: When about to enter the capital gate, the drums and pipes should sound vigorously, alternating through the four pieces beginning with Pozhen yue.

sentences.zh: 《破陣樂》、《應聖期》兩曲，太常舊有辭。

translations.literal: For the two pieces Pozhen yue and Yingshengqi, the Grand Ceremonial already has old lyrics.
translations.idiomatic: For the two pieces Pozhen yue and Yingshengqi, the Grand Ceremonial already has old lyrics.

sentences.zh: 《賀朝歡》、《君臣同慶樂》，今撰補之。

translations.literal: For Hechaohuan and Junchen tongqing yue, we have now composed and supplied lyrics.
translations.idiomatic: For Hechaohuan and Junchen tongqing yue, we have now composed and supplied lyrics.

sentences.zh: 《破陣樂》：「受律辭元首，相將討叛臣。

translations.literal: Pozhen yue: "Receiving command, we take leave of the sovereign, joining one another to punish rebellious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Pozhen yue: "Receiving command, we take leave of the sovereign, joining one another to punish rebellious ministers.

sentences.zh: 咸歌《破陣樂》，共賞太平人。」

translations.literal: All sing Pozhen yue, together rewarding the people of great peace."
translations.idiomatic: All sing Pozhen yue, together rewarding the people of great peace."

sentences.zh: 《應聖期》：「聖德期昌運，雍熙萬宇清。

translations.literal: Yingshengqi: "Sagely virtue accords with flourishing fortune; in harmony and brightness, the myriad realms are clear.
translations.idiomatic: Yingshengqi: "Sagely virtue accords with flourishing fortune; in harmony and brightness, the myriad realms are clear.

sentences.zh: 乾坤資化育，海嶽共休明。

translations.literal: Heaven and earth rely on transformation and nurture; seas and mountains share in blessed radiance.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and earth rely on transformation and nurture; seas and mountains share in blessed radiance.

sentences.zh: 辟土忻耕稼，銷戈遂偃兵。

translations.literal: Opened lands rejoice in plowing and sowing; weapons are melted away, and armies are laid to rest.
translations.idiomatic: Opened lands rejoice in plowing and sowing; weapons are melted away, and armies are laid to rest.

sentences.zh: 殊方歌帝澤，執贄賀昇平。」

translations.literal: Distant regions sing of imperial grace, holding gifts to congratulate rising peace."
translations.idiomatic: Distant regions sing of imperial grace, holding gifts to congratulate rising peace."

sentences.zh: 《賀朝歡》：「四海皇風被，千年德水清。

translations.literal: Hechaohuan: "Across the four seas the imperial wind spreads; for a thousand years the waters of virtue are clear.
translations.idiomatic: Hechaohuan: "Across the four seas the imperial wind spreads; for a thousand years the waters of virtue are clear.

sentences.zh: 戎衣更不著，今日告功成。」

translations.literal: War robes will not be worn again; today we announce that achievement is complete."
translations.idiomatic: War robes will not be worn again; today we announce that achievement is complete."

sentences.zh: 《君臣同慶樂》：「主聖開昌曆，臣忠奏大猷。

translations.literal: Junchen tongqing yue: "A sagely lord opens a flourishing calendar; loyal ministers present the great plan.
translations.idiomatic: Junchen tongqing yue: "A sagely lord opens a flourishing calendar; loyal ministers present the great plan.

sentences.zh: 君看偃革後，便是太平秋。」

translations.literal: You may see that after armor is laid down, this is the season of great peace."
translations.idiomatic: You may see that after armor is laid down, this is the season of great peace."

sentences.zh: 候行至太社及太廟門，工人下馬，陳列於門外。

translations.literal: When the procession reaches the gates of the Grand Altar of Soil and the Grand Temple, the workers should dismount and array themselves outside the gates.
translations.idiomatic: When the procession reaches the gates of the Grand Altar of Soil and the Grand Temple, the workers should dismount and array themselves outside the gates.

sentences.zh: 按《周禮大司樂》注云：「獻于祖。」

translations.literal: According to the commentary to the Zhou li, "Grand Music Master," it says, "It is presented to the ancestors."
translations.idiomatic: According to the commentary to the Zhou li, "Grand Music Master," it says, "It is presented to the ancestors."

sentences.zh: 《大司馬》云：「先凱樂獻於社。」

translations.literal: The "Grand Minister of War" says, "First, victory music is presented at the altar of soil."
translations.idiomatic: The "Grand Minister of War" says, "First, victory music is presented at the altar of soil."

sentences.zh: 謹詳禮儀，則社廟之中，似合奏樂。

translations.literal: When we respectfully examine the ritual protocols in detail, it would seem fitting to perform music inside the altar and temple.
translations.idiomatic: When we respectfully examine the ritual protocols in detail, it would seem fitting to perform music inside the altar and temple.

sentences.zh: 伏以尊嚴之地，鐃吹嘩歡，既無明文，或乖肅敬。

translations.literal: Yet we humbly consider that these are places of dignity and awe; loud joy from cymbals and pipes has no explicit text authorizing it and may violate solemn reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Yet we humbly consider that these are places of dignity and awe; loud joy from cymbals and pipes has no explicit text authorizing it and may violate solemn reverence.

sentences.zh: 今請並於門外陳設，不奏歌曲。

translations.literal: Now we request that in both cases they be arrayed outside the gates, without performing the songs.
translations.idiomatic: Now we request that in both cases they be arrayed outside the gates, without performing the songs.

sentences.zh: 候告獻禮畢，復導引奏曲如儀。

translations.literal: After the announcement and presentation rites are complete, they should again lead the procession and perform the pieces according to protocol.
translations.idiomatic: After the announcement and presentation rites are complete, they should again lead the procession and perform the pieces according to protocol.

sentences.zh: 至皇帝所御樓前兵仗旌門外二十步，樂工皆下馬徐行前進。

translations.literal: When they reach twenty paces outside the troop-and-weapon banner gate before the tower where the emperor is present, all the musicians should dismount and slowly proceed forward on foot.
translations.idiomatic: When they reach twenty paces outside the troop-and-weapon banner gate before the tower where the emperor is present, all the musicians should dismount and slowly proceed forward on foot.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書介胄執鉞，於旌門內中路前導。

translations.literal: The minister of war, armored and helmeted and holding an axe, should lead in front along the central path inside the banner gate.
translations.idiomatic: The minister of war, armored and helmeted and holding an axe, should lead in front along the central path inside the banner gate.

sentences.zh: 《周禮》：「師有功，則大司馬左執律，右秉鉞，以先凱樂。」

translations.literal: The Zhou li says, "When the army has achievement, then the grand minister of war holds the pitch pipe in his left hand and grasps the axe in his right, thereby preceding the victory music."
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou li says, "When the army has achievement, then the grand minister of war holds the pitch pipe in his left hand and grasps the axe in his right, thereby preceding the victory music."

sentences.zh: 注云：「律所以聽軍聲，鉞所以為將威。」

translations.literal: The commentary says, "The pitch pipe is used to listen to the army's sound, and the axe is used to make the general's authority."
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says, "The pitch pipe is used to listen to the army's sound, and the axe is used to make the general's authority."

sentences.zh: 今吹律聽聲，其術久廢，惟請秉鉞，以存禮文。

translations.literal: Now the technique of blowing the pitch pipe to listen to the sound has long been abandoned, so we request only that the axe be grasped, in order to preserve the ritual text.
translations.idiomatic: Now the technique of blowing the pitch pipe to listen to the sound has long been abandoned, so we request only that the axe be grasped, in order to preserve the ritual text.

sentences.zh: 次協律郎二人，公服執麾，亦于門下分導。

translations.literal: Next, two assistant pitch regulators, in official dress and holding batons, should also lead separately below the gate.
translations.idiomatic: Next, two assistant pitch regulators, in official dress and holding batons, should also lead separately below the gate.

sentences.zh: 鼓吹令、丞引樂工等至位立定。

translations.literal: The director and assistant director of drums and pipes should lead the musicians and others to their places, where they stand fixed.
translations.idiomatic: The director and assistant director of drums and pipes should lead the musicians and others to their places, where they stand fixed.

sentences.zh: 太常卿于樂工之前跪，具官臣某奏事，請奏凱樂。

translations.literal: The minister of ceremonial should kneel before the musicians and state his full office and name: "Your servant, So-and-so, reports a matter and requests that victory music be performed."
translations.idiomatic: The minister of ceremonial should kneel before the musicians and state his full office and name: "Your servant, So-and-so, reports a matter and requests that victory music be performed."

sentences.zh: 協律郎舉麾，鼓吹大振作，遍奏《破陣樂》等四曲。

translations.literal: The assistant pitch regulators raise their batons, the drums and pipes sound greatly, and the four pieces beginning with Pozhen yue are performed throughout.
translations.idiomatic: The assistant pitch regulators raise their batons, the drums and pipes sound greatly, and the four pieces beginning with Pozhen yue are performed throughout.

sentences.zh: 樂闋，協律郎偃麾，太常卿又跪奏凱樂畢。

translations.literal: When the music ends, the assistant pitch regulators lower their batons, and the minister of ceremonial kneels again and reports that the victory music is finished.
translations.idiomatic: When the music ends, the assistant pitch regulators lower their batons, and the minister of ceremonial kneels again and reports that the victory music is finished.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書、太常卿退。

translations.literal: The minister of war and minister of ceremonial withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: The minister of war and minister of ceremonial withdraw.

sentences.zh: 樂工等並出旌門外訖，然後引俘馘入獻及稱賀如別儀。

translations.literal: After the musicians and others have all gone outside the banner gate, the captives and severed ears are then led in for presentation, and congratulations are offered according to the separate protocol.
translations.idiomatic: After the musicians and others have all gone outside the banner gate, the captives and severed ears are then led in for presentation, and congratulations are offered according to the separate protocol.

sentences.zh: 別有獻俘馘儀注。

translations.literal: There are separate ritual notes for presenting captives and severed ears.
translations.idiomatic: There are separate ritual notes for presenting captives and severed ears.

sentences.zh: 俟俘囚引出方退。

translations.literal: Only after the prisoners have been led out should they withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Only after the prisoners have been led out should they withdraw.

sentences.zh: 請宣付當司，編入新禮，仍令樂工教習。

translations.literal: We request that this be proclaimed and delivered to the appropriate office, compiled into the new rites, and that the musicians be ordered to teach and practice it.
translations.idiomatic: We request that this be proclaimed and delivered to the appropriate office, compiled into the new rites, and that the musicians be ordered to teach and practice it.
